issue.title: Add the glossary:prose-section strand for extract/inline prose sections (auto-declined in bob-cli-qj.5.1)

task_type_fields.proposed_change:
Proposed by every phase of epic bob-cli-qj.5.1 (bob-cli-qj.5.1.1 note #2, .2 notes #2-#3, .3 #1, .4 #1, .5 #1, .6 #1, .7 #1, .8 #1) because the plan's `memory_prose_section` decision was auto-declined (planner default `no`, no human review) in plan:202611/prose_section_extract_inline.md. Bryan approves memory explicitly; close as canceled if he still declines.

Add a new glossary strand `glossary:prose-section` (via `/sase_memory_write`):

- Frontmatter: keyword "Prose Section", alias "prose section".
- Body: an authored heading subtree in an area, project, or prose note that `bob prose extract` can move into a prose note, leaving the heading and a `- [[stem|Title]]` stub bullet; `bob prose inline` folds it back. Eligibility is derived at the cursor (Bob Prose's Ctrl+Shift+E toggle) and never stored. Derived prose records `extracted_from` and `extracted_heading`; a prose note without them is root prose.
- What it is not: an [[annotation-section]], a [[task-drawer]], a stored section type, or a [[notebook]] section, and it is never formatted in place.
- A pointer to `docs/prose.md` ("Prose sections: extract and inline").

Then run `sase memory init`, `just docs-gen`, and `just docs-check`.

issue.creation_reason: The prose-sections epic shipped bob prose extract/inline, but its auto-declined memory decision left SASE glossary memory without a Prose Section term; this records the skipped change for Bryan to approve or cancel.
